{{Quote|Where are my soldiers?''"<br />"''I don't know, Lord Vader.''"<br />"''I won't repeat myself soldier.''"<br />"''They're being detained&hellip; here.|Darth Vader questions the soldier|<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
A '''Zalor Militiaman''' was from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zaloriis/Legends|Zaloriis]] and a member of the [[Zalorian Separatists]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Militiaman participated in an ambush against [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], and was questioned on the location of captured Imperial forces, and was then [[Death/Legends|killed]].
